G1900.def:
ἐπ-έκεινα 
adv. (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: Lévitique 22:27, Nombres 32:19, al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;] 
beyond; with genitive, Actes 7:43 (LXX) †

G1901.def:
ἐπ-εκ-τείνω 
to extend: mid., to stretch forward: with dative, Philippiens 3:13.†

G1902.def:
ἐπ-εν-δύω
= -δύνω (Hdt.), 
to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: 2 Corinthiens 5:2-4.†

G1903.def:
ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל Lévitique 8:7 A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), 3Ki.18:4 A, 4Ki.13:18 * ;] 
an outer tunic (RV, coat): Jean 21:7 .†

G1904.def:
ἐπ-έρχομαι, 
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Actes 14:19 (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, Éphésiens 2:7. 
__2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, Luc 21:26, Actes 8:24 13:40, Jacques 5:1; of an enemy, Luc 11:22; of the Holy Spirit, Luc 1:35, Actes 1:8, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, Juges 14:6, 3Ki.11:6, al.].†

G1905.def:
ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;] 
__1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), Marc 12:34, Luc 2:46, al.; with dupl. accusative, Marc 7:17 11:29, Luc 20:40, al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, Matthieu 12:18, Marc 9:11; εἰ, Marc 8:23, Luc 23:6, al.; ἐ. θεόν, Romains 10:20 (LXX). 
__2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., Matthieu 16:1 (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716)

G1906.def:
ἐπ-ερώτημα, -τος, τό 
[in LXX: Da TH Daniel 4:14 (שְׁאֵלָא), Sir.33:3 * ;] 
__1. a question, au inquiry (Hdt., Thuc.). 
__2. a demand: 1 Pierre 3:21 (see ICC, in l).†

G1907.def:
ἐπ-έχω 
[in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also Sir.8:1 34:2, 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 9:25, al. ;] 
__1. to hold upon. 
__2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), to hold out, offer: λόγον ζωῆς, Philippiens 2:16. 
__3. to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν; 
__(a) absol., to intend, purpose; 
__(b) to observe, give attention to (see MM, Exp., xiv): before πῶς, Luc 14:7; with dative of person(s), Actes 3:5, 1 Timothée 4:16. 
__4. to stay, wait: Actes 19:22 (in legal phrase, MM, Exp., l.with).†

G1908.def:
ἐπηρεάζω
(ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse), 
to revile: with accusative of person(s), Luc 6:28; with accusative of thing(s) (but see ICC, in l), 1 Pierre 3:16.†

G1909.def:
ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽), 
prep. with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT), 
with primary sense of superposition, on, upon. 
__I. C. genitive, 
__1. of place, answering the question, where? 
__(a) of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, Matthieu 6:10, 19, al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, 1 Corinthiens 11:10; τ. νεφελῶν, Matthieu 24:3o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, Marc 4:26; σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, Hébreux 6:7, al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, Galates 3:16; of power or authority, over, πάντων, Romains 9:5: τ. γάζης, Actes 8:27; ἐξουσία, Apocalypse 2:26 20:6; 
__(b) of vicinity, at, by: τ. θαλάσσης, Jean 6:9; τ. ὁδοῦ, Matthieu 21:19; τοῦ βάτου, Marc 12:26 (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), in the presence of, before, Matthieu 28:14, Actes 23:30, 1 Corinthiens 6:1, al. 
__2. Of time, 
__(a) with genitive of person(s), in the time of: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, Luc 4:27; ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, Actes 11:28; ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, when A. was high priest, Marc 2:26; 
__(b) with genitive of thing(s), at, at the time of: Matthieu 1:11, Hébreux 1:2, 2 Pierre 3:3; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, Romains 1:10, Éphésiens 1:16, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:2, Phm 4. 
__II. C. dative, of place, answering the question, where? 
__(a) lit., on, upon: Matthieu 9:16, 14:8, al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (a)), Matthieu 9:16 Actes 8:16; above, Luc 23:38; at, by, Marc 13:29, Jean 5:2, Actes 5:9, al.; 
__(b) metaphorically, upon, on the ground of, Luc 4:4 (LXX); in the matter of, Marc 6:52 (see Swete, in l.); upon, of, concerning, Actes 5:35, 40; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), Matthieu 18:3 19:9, Romains 12:12, al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, for the reason that, because, Romains 5:12 2 Corinthiens 5:4; after verbs of motion, over, Matthieu 18:13, Romains 16:19, al.; of a condition (cl.), Romains 8:20, 1 Corinthiens 9:10; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on Hébreux 9:10), Hébreux 10:28; of purpose or aim, Éphésiens 2:10, Philippiens 4:10; of authority, over, Matthieu 24:47 Luc 12:44; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), against, Luc 12:52; in addition to (cl.), 2 Corinthiens 7:13; of an adjunct, in, at, on, Philippiens 1:3 2:17. 
__III. C. accusative, 
__1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither? 
__(a) lit., upon, over: Matthieu 14:28, 29, Luc 5:19, al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), Marc 4:38 11:2, Luc 2:25, Jean 1:32; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, Actes 1:15 2:1, al.; of motion to a vicinity, to, Marc 16:2, Actes 8:36, al.; 
__(b) metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 10:13 12:28, Actes 2:17, Jean 18:4, Éphésiens 5:6, al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, Philippiens 2:27; ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), Actes 15:17, Jacques 2:7; καλεῖν ἐπί, to call after, Luc 1:59; of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), thrice, Actes 10:16 11:10; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, the more, further, Actes 4:17 2 Timothée 2:16 3:9 (see also infr., 2, (a)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), forasmuch as, Matthieu 25:40, 45, Romains 11:13; of power, authority, control, Luc 1:33, Actes 7:10 Romains 5:14, Hébreux 3:6, al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, unto, towards, Luc 1:17 23:28, Actes 9:35, 42, Romains 11:22, Galates 4:9, Éphésiens 2:7, 1 Timothée 5:5, al.; of purpose, for, Matthieu 3:7, Luc 23:48; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, Matthieu 26:50; of hostility, against, Matthieu 24:7, Marc 3:24-26 10:11 13:8, Luc 9:5, Jean 13:18, Actes 7:54, 1 Corinthiens 7:36, 2 Corinthiens 1:23; Of reference, concerning, for (cl. usually dative), Marc 9:12 15:24, Jean 19:24, Romains 4:9. 
__2. Of time, 
__(a) during, for: Luc 4:25 (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), Actes 13:31 16:18, Hébreux 11:30, al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), as long as, for so long time as, Marc 9:15 Romains 7:1, al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (b)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), Actes 20:11; ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), yet longer, further, Actes 20:9 24:4; 
__(b) on, about, towards (cl. εἰς): Luc 10:35 Actes 3:1 4:5. 
__IV. In composition, ἐπί signifies: up, ἐπαίρω; upon, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; towards, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; over (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; again, in addition, ἐπαιτέω; against, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή.

G1910.def:
ἐπι-βαίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;] 
__1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, Matthieu 21:5 (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, Actes 27:2; before εἰς, Actes 21:6 (Rec.); absol., Actes 21:2. 
__2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, Actes 20:18 21:4; with dative, Actes 25:1.†

G1911.def:
ἐπι-βάλλω 
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, Marc 11:7, 1 Corinthiens 7:35; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, Apocalypse 18:10, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Matthieu 26:50, Luc 20:19 21:12, Jean 7:30, Actes 5:18 21:27; with dative (Polyb.), Marc 14:46 Actes 4:3; with inf., Actes 12:1; τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, Luc 9:62; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, Luc 5:36; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, Matthieu 9:16. 
__2. Intrans., 
__(a) to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Marc 4:37; metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): Marc 14:72 (see also Swete, in l); 
__(b) to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), Luc 15:12.†

G1912.def:
ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ 
to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., 2 Corinthiens 2:6; with accusative of person(s), 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8 (cf. M, Th., I, 29).†

G1913.def:
ἐπι-βιβάζω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;] 
to place upon: with accusative of person(s), Luc 10:34 19:35, Actes 23:24.†

G1914.def:
ἐπι-βλέπω 
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;] 
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (1 Rois 1:11 9:1, Psaumes 25:16; Tob.3:3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Luc 1:48 9:38, Jacques 2:3.†

G1915.def:
ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 3:22 * ;] 
__1. that which is thrown over, a cover. 
__2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with). 
__3. that which is put on; 
__(a) embroidery; 
__(b) a patch: Matthieu 9:16, Marc 2:21, Luc 5:36.†

G1917.def:
ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Esther 2:22, I Esther 5:73, 2Ma.5:7, al. ;] 
a plan against, a plot: Actes 9:24 20:3, 19 23:30.†

G1918.def:
ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Genèse 34:9, 1 Rois 18:21 ff., 2 Chroniques 18:1, Esther 9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Genèse 38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;] 
__1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Genèse 38:8). 
__2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Genèse 38:8): with accusative, Matthieu 22:24.†

G1919.def:
ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ), 
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jean 3:12 Philippiens 2:10 3:19 (anarth.); σώματα, 1 Corinthiens 15:40; οἰκία, 2 Corinthiens 5:1; σοφία, Jacques 3:15 (Cremer, 153).†

G1920.def:
ἐπι-γίνομαι (see: γίνομαι) 
[in LXX: Ep. Jérémie 47:1-7, 3Ma.2:6 * ;] 
to arrive, arise, come on: Actes 28:13.†

G1922.def:
ἐπί-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιγινώσκω, which see), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:14 (B. γν-), Proverbes 2:5, Osée 4:1, 6 6:6 (דַּעַת), Jdth.9:14, 2Ma.9:11 * ;] 
acquaintance, discernment, recognition (Plut., al.): Philippiens 1:9, Colossiens 3:10; with genitive of thing(s), Colossiens 1:9 2:2, Phm 6; τ. ἀληθείας, 1 Timothée 2:4, 2 Timothée 2:25 3:7, Tite 1:1, Hébreux 10:26; τ. ἁμαρτίας, Romains 3:20; with genitive of person(s), of God: Éphésiens 1:17, Colossiens 1:10, 2 Pierre 1:2-3; of Christ: Éphésiens 4:13, 2 Pierre 1:8 2:20; of God and Christ: 2 Pierre 1:2; κατ ̓ ἐ., Romains 10:2; ἔχειν ἐν ἐ., Romains 1:28 (see AR, Eph., 248 ff.; and for a somewhat different view, Thayer, see word; Lft. on Col, 1:9; Tr., Syn., LXXv; Cremer, 159 f.; cf. αἴσθησις).†

G1923.def:
ἐπι-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιγράφω), 
an inscription: Matthieu 22:20, Marc 12:16 15:26, Luc 20:24 23:33.†

G1924.def:
ἐπι-γράφω 
[in LXX for כָּתַב, Nombres 17:2; fig., Jérémie 31:33, al. ;] 
to write upon, inscribe: Marc 15:26, Actes 17:23, Apocalypse 21:12; figuratively, Hébreux 8:10 (LXX) Hébreux 10:16.†

G1925.def:
ἐπι-δείκνυμι 
[in LXX: Proverbes 12:17 (פּוּחַ hi.), Ésaïe 37:26 (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, 2Ma.15:32, al ;] 
__1. to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, Matthieu 16:1 22:19 24:1, Luc 17:14. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): Actes 9:39. 
__2. to show, point out, prove: with accusative, Hébreux 6:17; with accusative and inf., Actes 18:28 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

G1926.def:
ἐπι-δέχομαι 
[in LXX: Jdth.13:13 B2, 1Ma.10:1 1Mac 14:23, Sir.51:26, al. ;] 
__1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers, 
__2. to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept (in π. of the terms of a lease; see ICC, on 3Jo, l.with): III Jn 9. 
__3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.); 
__(b) to receive hospitably (1Mac, Sir, ll with): III Jn 10†

G1927.def:
ἐπι-δημέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος); 
__1. to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.), 
__2. to stay in a place, sojourn (Plat., Xen., al.; and see MM, Exp., xiv): Actes 2:10 17:21; before ἐν, Actes 18:27 (WH, mg.).†

G1928.def:
ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι 
to add provisions to a document: Galates 3:15 (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).†

G1929.def:
ἐπι-δίδωμι 
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;] 
__1. to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Matthieu 7:9, 19, Luc 11:11-12 24:30, 42, Actes 15:30; pass. with dative of person(s), Luc 4:17. 
__2. to give in, give way: absol., Actes 27:15.†

G1930.def:
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω 
to set in order further: Tite 1:5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).†

G1931.def:
ἐπι-δύω 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 24:15, Josué 8:29, Jérémie 15:9 (בּוֹא)* ;] 
to go down, set (of the sun): Éphésiens 4:26.†

G1932.def:
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ 
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;] 
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Actes 24:4; with πραΰτης, 2 Corinthiens 10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii)

G1933.def:
ἐπιεικής, -ές
(εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Psaumes 86:5 (סַלָּח), Esther 8:13 * ;] 
__1. seemly, fitting (Hom.). 
__2. equitable, fair, moderate: 1 Timothée 3:3, Tite 3:2, 1 Pierre 2:18, Jacques 3:17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Philippiens 4:5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.with, and see: ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια see: ἐπιεικία
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ 
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;] 
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Actes 24:4; with πραΰτης, 2 Corinthiens 10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii)

G1934.def:
ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, 4Ki.8:8, Ésaïe 62:12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, 3Ki.20:1, Ecclésiaste 7:28), Osée 3:5; פָּקַד, 4Ki.3:8 ;] 
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv), 
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 6:32 12:39 16:4, Luc 12:30, Actes 19:39, Romains 11:7, Philippiens 4:17, Hébreux 11:14 13:14; with accusative of person(s), Luc 4:42, Actes 12:19; with inf., Actes 13:7.†

G1935.def:
ἐπιθανάτιος, -ον 
[in LXX: From Bel 1:31 ;] 
condemned to death: 1 Corinthiens 4:9.†

G1936.def:
ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 25:27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ez 23:11 (עֲגָבָה) 2Ma.4:41 2Mac 5:5 2Mac 14:15 * ;] 
__1. a laying on: χειρῶν, Actes 8:18, 1 Timothée 4:14, 2 Timothée 1:6, Hébreux 6:2 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with). 
__2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†

G1937.def:
ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;] 
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Jacques 4:2, Romains 7:7 13:9" (LXX), 1 Corinthiens 10:6 (of. 4Ma.2:6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), Galates 5:17; prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, Actes 20:33, 1 Timothée 3:1; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), Matthieu 5:28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Exode 20:17, Michée 2:2, Wis.16:3, al.); with inf., Matthieu 13:17, Luc 15:16 16:21 17:22, 1 Pierre 1:12, Apocalypse 9:6; with accusative and inf., Hébreux 6:11; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, Luc 22:15.†
SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453)

G1938.def:
ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Nombres 11:34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Proverbes 1:22 (חָמַד)* ;] 
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, 1 Corinthiens 10:6.†

G1939.def:
ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;] 
desire, longing: Luc 22:15 (see: ἐπιθυμέω), Philippiens 1:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17, Apocalypse 18:14; p1., Marc 4:19; esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Romains 7:7-8, Jacques 1:14-15, 2 Pierre 1:4; pl., Galates 5:24, 1 Timothée 6:9, 2 Timothée 2:22 4:3, 1 Pierre 1:14 4:2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:5; ἐ. κακή, Colossiens 3:5; with genitive, μιασμοῦ, 2 Pierre 2:10 (see Mayor, in l); τ. καρδιῶν, Romains 1:24; τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), 1 Jean 2:17; τ. σώματος, Romains 6:12; τ. ἀπάτης, Éphésiens 4:22 (see ICC, in l); τ. σαρκός, 1 Jean 2:16, 2 Pierre 2:18 (without art.), Galates 5:16; τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, 1 Jean 2:16; σαρκικαὶ ἐ., 1 Pierre 2:11 (cf. 4Ma.1:32); κοσμικαί, Tite 2:12; εἰς ἐπιθυμίας, Romains 13:14; ποιεῖν τὰς ἐ., Jean 8:44; ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐ., Romains 6:12; δουλεύειν, ἄγεσθαι, ἐπιθυμίαις, Tite 3:3, 2 Timothée 3:6; πορεύειθαι ἐν ἐ., 1 Pierre 4:3; κατά, Ju 16 18, 2 Pierre 3:3; ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐ., Éphésiens 2:3.†
SYN.: πάθος (which see), ὄρεξις

G1940.def:
ἐπι-καθ-ίζω 
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;] 
to sit upon: Matthieu 21:7.†

G1941.def:
ἐπι-καλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
__1. to call, name, surname: with accusative (cl.), Matthieu 10:25; pass., Actes 1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25, Hébreux 11:16; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb. עַל. . שֻׁם קָרָא), Actes 15:17 (LXX), Jacques 2:7 (see. CB on Amos 9:12). 
__2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, Actes 25:25), Actes 25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, Actes 7:59; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, 2 Corinthiens 1:23; πατέρα, 1 Pierre 1:17; τ. κύριον, Romains 10:12, 2 Timothée 2:22; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb. יְהוָֹה שֻׁם קָרָא), Actes 2:21 (LXX) Actes 9:14, 21 22:16, Romains 10:13-14" (LXX) 1 Corinthiens 1:2 (Cremer, 335, 742).†

G1942.def:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Exode 26:14 39:34, (מְכַסֶּה), 4Ki.17:19 (מָסָךְ), Job 19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;] 
a cover, veil: metaphorically, τ. κακίας, 1 Pierre 2:16.†

G1943.def:
ἐπι-καλύπτω 
[in LXX for כָּסָה, etc. ;] 
to cover over, cover up: metaphorically, Romains 4:7 (LXX).†

G1944.def:
ἐπι-κατ-άρατος, -ον
(ἐπικαταράομαι, to imprecate curses on), [in LXX for אָרַר, also Wis.3:12 14:8, 4Ma.2:19 ;] 
accursed: Galates 3:10 (LXX) Galates 3:13 (LXX κεκαταραμένος) (Cremer, 109).†

G1945.def:
ἐπι-κείμαι 
[in LXX: Exode 39:31 (נָתַן), Job 19:3 (הָכַר hi.) Job 21:27 (חָמַס), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.1:21, 3Ma.1:22 * ;] 
to be placed, lie on: Jean 21:9; before ἐπί, with dative, Jean 11:38; figuratively, Hébreux 9:10; ἀνάγκη, 1 Corinthiens 9:16; χειμῶν, to threaten, come on: Actes 27:20; of persons, to press upon: Luc 5:1 23:23.†

G1946.def:
Ἐπικούριος (Rec. -ειος), -ου, ὁ 
an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus: Actes 17:18.†

G1947.def:
ἐπικουρία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπικουρέω to be an ἐπίκουρος, an ally) [in LXX: Wis.13:18 * ;] 
aid, assistance: Actes 26:22.†

G1948.def:
ἐπι-κρίνω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:47, 3Ma.4:2 * ;] 
to decree, give sentence: with accusative and inf., Luc 23:24.†

G1949.def:
ἐπι-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;] 
always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), to lap hold of: with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 14:31, Actes 17:19 21:30, 33; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luc 9:47 14:4 23:26 (WH, but see Bl., 1015), Actes 9:27 16:9 18:17; with genitive of thing(s), Marc 8:23, Actes 23:10, Hébreux 8:9" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), Luc 20:20, 26; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, 1 Timothée 6:12 6:19. Metaphorical (as in Sir.4:11), Hébreux 2:16 (see Westc., in l).†

G1950.def:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;] 
to forget, neglect: with inf., Matthieu 16:5, Marc 8:14; with genitive, Hébreux 6:10 13:2, 16; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Philippiens 3:13; ὁποῖος ἦν, Jacques 1:24; pass. ptcp. (cf. Ésaïe 23:16, Sir.3:14 23:14, Wis.2:4), Luc 12:6.†

G1951.def:
ἐπι-λέγω 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;] 
__1. to say in addition (Hdt.). 
__2. to call by name, to call: Jean 5:2. 
__3. to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: Actes 15:40.†

G1952.def:
ἐπι-λείπω 
[in LXX: Ob 5 א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;] 
to fail: with accusative of person(s), Hébreux 11:32.†

G1953.def:
ἐπι-λησμονή, -ις, ή
(επιλήθω), [in LXX: Sir.11:27 * ;] 
forgetful­ness: ἀκροατὴς ἐ. (genitive of qual.), Jacques 1:25.†

G1954.def:
ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;] 
still left, remaining: χρόνος, 1 Pierre 4:2.†

G1955.def:
ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Genèse 40:8; Sm.: Osée 3:4 * ;] 
__1. release. 
__2. solution, interpretation: 2 Pierre 1:20.†

G1956.def:
ἐπι-λύω 
[in Aq.: Genèse 40:8 41:8, 12; Th.: Osée 3:4 * ;] 
__1. to loose, release. 
__2. to solve, settle, explain: Marc 4:34, Actes 19:39.†

G1957.def:
ἐπι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ 
to bear witness to: with accusative and inf., 1 Pierre 5:12,†

G1958.def:
ἐπιμέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιμελέομαι), [in LXX: Proverbes 3:8 (שִׁקּוּי), Wis.13:13, Esther 6:10, 1Ma.16:14, al. ;] 
attention, care: Actes 27:3 (see Field, Notes, 143).†

G1959.def:
ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX: Genèse 44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Esther 6:27, Proverbes 27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;] 
to take care of: with genitive, Luc 10:34-35, 1 Timothée 3:5.†

G1960.def:
ἐπιμελῶς 
adv., [in LXX for רַק, etc. ;] 
carefully: Luc 15:8.†

G1961.def:
ἐπι-μένω 
[in LXX: Exode 12:39 (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;] 
to stay on, tarry or abide still: before έν, 1 Corinthiens 16:8; αὐτοῦ, there, Actes 15:34 (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) Actes 21:4; with dative, τ. σαρκί, Philippiens 1:24; before παρά, with dative of person(s), Actes 28:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 16:7, Galates 1:18; with accusative temp., Actes 10:48 21:4, 10 28:12, 14, 1 Corinthiens 16:7. Metaphorical, to continue in a pursuit or state: with dative, τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, Romains 6:1; τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, Romains 11:23; τ. πίστει, Colossiens 1:23; αὐτοῖς (see CGT, in l), 1 Timothée 4:16; τ. χρηστότητι, Romains 11:22; with ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), Jean 8:7, Actes 12:16.†

G1962.def:
ἐπι-νεύω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 26:24 (נָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 11:15 2Mac 14:20 * ;] 
to nod in command or approval, to nod approval, consent: Actes 18:20.†

G1963.def:
ἐπίνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπινοέω, to contrive) [in LXX: Jérémie 20:10, Wis.6:16 9:14 14:12 15:4, Sir.40:2, 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.17:2 * ;] 
a thought, design: Actes 8:22.†

G1964.def:
ἐπιορκέω, -ῶ
(ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I Esther 1:48, Wis.14:28 * ;] 
to swear falsely, forswear oneself: Matthieu 5:33.†

G1965.def:
ἐπί-ορκος, -ον 
[in LXX: Zacharie 5:3 (שָׁבַע ni.) * ;] 
__1. of oaths, sworn falsely. 
__2. Of persons, perjured; as subst., a perjurer, false swearer: 1 Timothée 1:10.†

G1966.def:
ἔπ-ειμι 
[in LXX: Exode 8:22 (עָמַד), Sir.42:19, etc. ;] 
__1. to come upon, approach 
__2. Of time, to come on or after; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, next, following: τῇ- ἔ. (sc.ἡμέρᾳ, as frequently in late Gk.), Actes 16:11 20:15 21:18; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), Actes 7:26; νυκτί, Actes 23:11.†

G1967.def:
ἐπιούσιος, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, etc.]), 
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: Matthieu 6:11, Luc 11:3. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning. 
__1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.). 
__2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.); 
__(b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).†

G1968.def:
ἐπι-πίπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;] 
to fall upon (Field, Notes, 25): with dative of person(s), Marc 3:10 (see Swete, in l), Actes 20:10; before ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as Genèse 46:29, Tob.11:8, 3Ma.5:49, al.), Luc 15:20, Actes 20:37. Metaphorical, φόβος, Luc 1:12, Actes 19:17, Apocalypse 11:11; ὀνειδισμοί, Romains 15:3 (LXX); of the Holy Spirit: before ἐπί, with dative, Actes 8:16; ἐπί, with accusative, Actes 10:44 11:15; absol., Actes 23:7.†

G1969.def:
ἐπι-πλήσσω 
__1. to strike at, to punish. 
__2. to rebuke, reprove: 1 Timothée 5:1.†

G1971.def:
ἐπι-ποθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for יָאַב, אָרַג, כָּסַף hi., etc. ;] 
to long for, desire: with inf., Romains 1:11, 2 Corinthiens 5:2, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:6, 2 Timothée 1:4, Philippiens 2:26 (WH, [txt.]); with accusative of thing(s), 1 Pierre 2:2; with accusative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 9:14, Philippiens 1:8 2:26 (WH, mg); absol., Jacques 4:5 (see Mayor, in l).†

G1972.def:
ἐπι-πόθησις, -εως, ἡ 
[in Aq.: Eze.23:11 * ;] 
longing: 2 Corinthiens 7:7 7:11.†

G1973.def:
ἐπι-πόθητος, -ον 
greatly desired, longed for: Philippiens 4:1.†

G1975.def:
ἐπι-πορεύομαι 
[in LXX: Lévitique 26:33 (אָחַר), Eze.39:14 (עָבַר), Ep. Jérémie 6:2, 2Ma.2:28, 3Ma.1:4 * ;] 
to travel, journey to: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Luc 8:4.†

G1976.def:
ἐπι-ράπτω (Rec. -ρράπτω), 
to sew upon: before ἐπί, with accusative, Marc 2:21.†

G1977.def:
ἐπι-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, as in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;] 
__1. to cast at. 
__2. to cast or place upon: with accusative before ἐπί, with accusative, Luc 19:35; metaphorically, τ. μέριμναν, 1 Pierre 5:7 (LXX).†

G1978.def:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Genèse 30:42 (קָשַׁר), Esther 5:4 8:13, 1Ma.11:37 1Mac 14:48, 2Ma.15:36, 3Ma.6:1 * ;] 
__1. bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined. 
__2. Metaphorical, 
__(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Romains 16:7; 
__(b) in bad sense, notorious: Matthieu 27:16.†

G1979.def:
ἐπισιτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: Genèse 42:25, al. (צֵידָה), Jdth.2:18 4:5 ;] 
__1. a foraging. 
__2. provisions, food: Luc 9:12.†

G1981.def:
ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ 
to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaphorically, before ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), 2 Corinthiens 12:9.†

G1982.def:
ἐπι-σκιάζω 
[in LXX: Exode 40:35 (שָׁכַן), Psaumes 91:4 140:7 (סָכַךְ), Proverbes 18:11 * ;] 
to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, Actes 5:15; of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. Exode 40:29, 35, 2Ma.2:8) cloud, with dative, Marc 9:7; with accusative, Matthieu 17:5, Luc 9:34; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, Luc 1:35.†

G1983.def:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, Hébreux 12:16. 
__2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: 1 Pierre 5:2 (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).†

G1984.def:
ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;] 
__1. a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment (Lévitique 19:20 Job 10:12, Jérémie 6:15, Wis.2:20, al.): Luc 19:44, 1 Pierre 2:12 (see Hort, in l). 
__2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): Actes 1:20 (LXX), 1 Timothée 3:1 (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809b).†

G1985.def:
ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
(σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, Nombres 4:16 31:14, Juges 9:28, 4Ki.11:15 11:18, 2 Chroniques 34:12 34:17, Néhémie 11:9, 14 11:22; אֵל, Job 20:29; נָגַשׂ:, Ésaïe 60:17; Wis.1:6, 1Ma.1:51 * ;] 
a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. see LS, see word): Actes 20:28, 1 Pierre 2:25 (ICC, in l); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: Philippiens 1:1, 1 Timothée 3:2, Tite 1:7 (see reff. see word ἐπισκοπή).†

G1986.def:
ἐπι-σπάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 5:18 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;] 
to draw on: mid., in peculiar sense of effacing signs of Judaism (cf. 1Ma.1:15, FlJ, Ant., xii, 5, i; see Thayer, see word), to become as uncircumcised: 1 Corinthiens 7:18.†

G1987.def:
ἐπίσταμαι
(prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, which see), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;] 
to know, know of, understand: with accusative of person(s), Actes 19:15; with ptcp., Actes 24:10; with accusative of thing(s), Marc 14:68, Actes 18:25, 1 Timothée 6:4, Jacques 4:14, Ju 10; before περί, Actes 26:26; ὅτι, Actes 15:7 19:25 22:19; ὡς, Actes 10:28; πῶς, Actes 20:18; ποῦ, Hébreux 11:8.†
SYN: γινώσκω (which see), οἶδα

G1988.def:
ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό
(ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 4Ki.25:19, Jérémie 29:26 52:25 (פָּקִיד), 2 Chroniques 31:12 (נָגִיד), 2Ma.5:22, etc. ;] 
a chief, commander, master: Luc 5:5 8:24, 45 9:33, 49 17:13 (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).†

G1989.def:
ἐπι-στέλλω 
[in LXX: 3Ki.5:8 Néhémie 6:19 (שָׁלַח), Jdth.15:4, 1Ma.10:25 1Mac 12:7 1Mac 13:18 (in each case with seel. ἀποσ-) * ;] 
__1. to send to. 
__2. to send a message by letter, to write word (MM, Exp., xiv): with dative of person(s), Actes 21:25, Hébreux 13:22; before τοῦ, with inf., Actes 15:20.†

G1990.def:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: Deutéronome 1:13 4:6, Ésaïe 5:21 (בִּין ni.), I Esther 8:44, Sir.10:25 21:15, etc. ;] 
knowing, skilled: Jacques 3:13.†

G1991.def:
ἐπι-στηρίζω 
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;] 
to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, Actes 14:22 15:32, 41.†

G1992.def:
ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;] 
__1. a message. 
__2. a letter, an epistle: Actes 9:2, 1 Corinthiens 5:9, al.; pl., Actes 22:5, 1 Corinthiens 16:3, al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, 2 Corinthiens 3:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)

G1993.def:
ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα), 
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tite 1:11.†

G1994.def:
ἐπι-στρέφω 
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Luc 1:16-17 (cf. Malachie 3:24), Jacques 5:19-20. 
__2. Intrans., 
__(a) to turn, turn oneself around: Actes 16:18; with inf., Apocalypse 1:12; before πρός, Actes 9:40; so also pass. (cl.), Marc 5:30 8:33, Jean 21:20; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), Actes 9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20; πρὸς τ. θεόν, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:9, 2 Corinthiens 3:16; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, Actes 26:18; pass., 1 Pierre 2:25; 
__(b) to return (as in MGr.): Luc 8:55, Actes 15:36; before ὀπίσω, with inf., Matthieu 24:18; before εἰς, Matthieu 12:44, Marc 13:16, Luc 2:39 17:31; ἐπί, 2 Pierre 2:22; metaphorically, before ἐπί, Galates 4:9; πρός, Luc 17:4; of moral reform, Matthieu 13:15, Marc 4:12, Luc 22:32, Actes 3:19 28:27; pass., Matthieu 10:13 (Cremer, 531, 881).†

G1995.def:
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Eze.47:7 (שׁוּב), Sir.18:21 49:2, etc. ;] 
a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): Actes 15:3.†

G1996.def:
ἐπι-συν-άγω 
[in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;] 
__1. to gather together: Matthieu 23:37 24:31, Marc 13:27, Luc 13:34; pass., Marc 1:33, Luc 12:1 17:37, (cf. Psaumes 102:23 106:47, 2Ma.1:27, al.). 
__2. to gather together against (Michée 4:11, Zacharie 12:3, 1Ma.3:58, al.).†

G1997.def:
ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:7 * ;] 
a gathering together, assembly: Hébreux 10:25; before ἐπί, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:1 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†

G1998.def:
ἐπι-συν-τρέχω 
to run together again: Marc 9:25 (see Swete, in l).†
